entries.summary: Neutral — Downside Risk maintained. Thursday premarket Nasdaq-100 futures weakness and NVDA/chipmaker declines remain the principal risk, but no confirmed cash-session SOX/QQQ breakdown or Nvidia CEO removal. New secondary reporting suggests 10Y near 4.99%, 2Y near 4.76%, QQQ -0.78% premarket, and December hike probability 92.8%; these are unsynchronized indicative readings and not verified official Treasury/FedWatch observations. Await claims, opening breadth and Friday PPI.
bullish: November 11 Nasdaq +1.60% and SOX +5.7% regular-session closes, both before the Nvidia governance reports.
Foxconn's AI rack demand outlook and Fractile financing show AI infrastructure investment continues; no attributable market confirmation.
Official Nvidia leadership continuity, resilient SOX relative to QQQ and contained yields/volatility could support recovery.
bearish: Reuters November 12 reports NVDA approximately -7% premarket and Nasdaq-100 futures -0.79%; Intel, Marvell and Micron approximately -2.6% to -3.4% premarket, a wider but still premarket reaction.
No confirmed Nvidia CEO removal; uncertainty and funding exposure remain risks.
December Fed hike risk and Friday PPI constrain growth-stock valuations; current synchronized yields/VXN/breadth unavailable.

editorial.marketOverview: Nasdaq and semiconductors enter Thursday under leadership uncertainty at Nvidia. Reuters reports Nasdaq-100 futures down 0.79%, Nvidia down about 7% premarket, and Intel, Marvell and Micron down 2.6–3.4%. These are premarket observations, not Thursday closing outcomes. Wednesday's Nasdaq +1.60% and SOX +5.7% gains predate the new risk.
editorial.whatChanged: Compared with the 05:31 ET assessment, secondary reporting adds QQQ down 0.78% premarket, 10Y near 4.99%, 2Y near 4.76%, and a 92.8% December hike probability. Quote times are not synchronized and FedWatch was not independently verified. No confirmed Nvidia board decision or new attributable cash-market breakdown changes the bias.
editorial.marketInterpretation: The AI capex demand narrative remains constructive, as shown by Foxconn and CoreWeave, but NVDA leadership uncertainty threatens sector confidence and financing links. Secondary yields suggest an indicative +23 bp 10Y–2Y spread, correctly scaled, versus the historical November 10 +25.7 bp. Rates and Fed probabilities are not a clean synchronized snapshot.
editorial.threeDayPath: Thursday Nov 12: volatile gap and price discovery; watch whether semiconductor selling persists after the open and whether QQQ breadth broadens. Friday Nov 13: October PPI could amplify or offset duration pressure. Monday Nov 16: assess persistence or reversal after the macro reaction and any Nvidia governance clarification.
editorial.bullCase: Official leadership continuity, resilience in Nvidia's customers, and SOX regaining leadership over QQQ could convert the premarket shock into a recovery. Lower yields and contained VXN/VIX would strengthen this, but neither is yet verified synchronously.
editorial.bearCase: An abrupt confirmed leadership change, persistent NVDA/SOX underperformance, widening negative breadth and higher yields or volatility could turn the current neutral/downside-risk stance into a bearish outlook. Hot PPI would intensify that setup.
editorial.watchNext: Verify Thursday jobless claims and Treasury reaction; Nvidia board communications; cash-market QQQ, SOX, breadth, VXN/VIX; Applied Materials and Cisco earnings timing/results; Friday PPI; Monday follow-through. Do not attribute price changes to catalysts without evidence.
